Static ABC rendering (DSL Slice 2)
Build-time notation

In static mode the abc handler's contract markup is replaced, at compile time, by inline SVG. The page that opens this document needs no abcjs bundle and no init script: the notation is already drawn. This is the build-time path that live mode and the <pre> contract (RQ-DSL-M2) set up.

A second excerpt with no id confirms the emit path handles both the id-bearing and the anonymous contract: the renderer runs on each marked block, and only the id-bearing one carries an id onto its <svg>.

Surrounding prose continues to render normally — the replacement is scoped to the abc contract elements and leaves everything else untouched.
